name: Park a registered secondmate and read its durable private UTC-dated owner record
Run restart and the session-start recovery sweep; a parked missing mate remains stopped with no launch attempt
Ordinary monitoring refuses recovery without creating a crash-loop marker or relaunch ledger
Explicit fresh spawn, replacement, control relaunch and remote relaunch all refuse a parked mate
Crash-loop rearm preserves owner park and only explicit unpark clears it
Park publication waits for an in-flight local spawn transaction to finish
Unregistered ids and malformed or symlink park records cannot authorize a launch or remove unrelated data
Remote publication waits for launch exclusion, blocks a late spawn in the receiving home, and rejects stale or wrong-mate updates
SSH connection failure cannot acknowledge park or unpark and retains local recovery refusal
